The [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated]] '''''Courier''-class yacht''' was a sleek and speedy [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] produced for the rich and those wanting a sporting craft.<ref name="JOY" />

==Characteristics==
The ''Courier''-class yacht was a long and sleek-hulled craft, aerodynamic, with a pair of trim wings that tipped upwards at the end.<ref name="JOY" /> At the base of these wings, twin engines were mounted, giving the craft excellent speed for its size.<ref name="JOY" />

Highly modifiable, [[Arend Shen]] modified his own ''Courier''-class yacht, the [[Venture (yacht)|''Venture'']], for extra luxury and extra speed.<ref name="JOY" /> Even after modifications, the yacht retained three extra hard points for further modification, owing to the versatility of the craft.<ref name="JOY" />

==Appearances==
*''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'' {{1st}}
